summary: No new update this turn. The run is within its final minutes, no experiment capacity existed at any point during my work, and every source area I can reach in this snapshot has now been read at least once, so rather than add a low value record I am re submitting the unchanged draft update48.json, the last accepted file, which the controller should treat as an exact unchanged update. Final state of the investigation: findings and bounded conclusions are recorded on consensus formation and progress and on context and authority transitions, with exact sources and locators for each claim; several protective mechanism and test coverage negatives are recorded so that a passing suite is not mistaken for coverage of the recorded behaviours; corrections are attached to the affected knowledge identifiers wherever later evidence narrowed or reframed an earlier assertion, and three pieces of contrary evidence against my own records are preserved in the open, namely that one recorded issue is already acknowledged by a repository TODO, that a documentation anchor I added was weakened by the same document's imprecise use of the peer and voter terms, and that my own illustrative example for the verification finding overstated the number of non-voters required; a paused handoff lists the five findings that still await an executed witness with the smallest execution for each, and one further question stays paused because its deciding material lies outside the captured snapshot. No stop declaration is made, since budget expiry is a controller boundary.
